title: Polynomial-time initial-configuration indicator
statement: Let $L$ be a language of bit strings decidable in logarithmic space. For each bit string $z$, let $x$ and $r$ be the first and second components returned by the total pair projections of $z$. Form the encoding whose first component is $x$ and whose second component pairs the length-$vwid(A,a,|x|)$ prefix of $r$ beginning at offset $vwid(A,a,|x|)$ with the binary expansion of $vrad(d,c,|x|)$. The function outputting the one-bit string whose bit is the indicator of membership of this encoding in the initial-configuration language for $N$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: The parameters $N,d,c,A,a$ are arbitrary as quantified
caveat: The statement depends on the initial-configuration language and the auxiliary functions $vwid$, $vrad$, and $cpAt$, whose informal definitions are not supplied here.
